protocol.serverCache: Running API/Next production servers; fixture preparation and earlier test cases warm the backend. Not a cold-server benchmark.
protocol.performanceScope: Local laboratory readiness snapshots; LCP and layout shifts measured at readiness, not field Core Web Vitals or INP. No score or measured improvement is claimed.
protocol.transportScope: CDP transport counters accumulate within each viewport test; navigation/resource/paint fields belong to each measured document.
protocol.accessibilityScope: Targeted keyboard/focus/reflow checks and separate root-font scaling; no native browser zoom or accessibility certification.
protocol.privacy: No form text, identities, cookies, headers or private response bodies are written into laboratory measurements.
